scope: Isolated local SQLite WAL database; synthetic rows, no real library or object storage access
cadence: Queue loop is 50 ms; enqueue runs once per maintenance, scheduled 1000 ms after maintenance settles, unless paused/stopping

plans.sql:
select o.id from media_objects o
    where o.purpose='original' and o.content_sha256 is null and o.status='stored'
    and exists(select 1 from media_versions v join media_images i on i.id=v.image_id
      join storage_configs s on s.id=i.storage_id
      where v.image_id=o.image_id and v.kind='original' and v.object_id=o.id
        and i.deletion_status is null and s.enabled=1) limit 1
plan: SEARCH o USING INDEX media_objects_missing_original_sha256 (purpose=? AND content_sha256=?)
SEARCH v USING INDEX sqlite_autoindex_media_versions_1 (image_id=? AND kind=?)
